comment.body: You already supplied the Alt+H-to-left example, the left/right/both-Alt comparison and the working Ctrl/Shift controls, so there is no need to repeat those. Could you share the active keyboard layout, exact Windows build, and one application where the first press fails? Those details will let us reproduce the same input path without assuming the uncertain update numbers are the cause.

proposed_fixes.title: Correct first-Alt chord state after release
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Alt-specific modifier bookkeeping or AltGr normalization may leave the first shortcut in a different state from subsequent presses.
